title: Avocado Cream for Sensitive Skin: How to Start Safely
ex: Avocado is usually gentle, but actives like kojic acid need a slow start. How to patch test and build up use at your skin's pace.
rt: Avocado Cream for Sensitive Skin: Start Slowly | Mirc Glow
rd: Using avocado cream for sensitive skin? Learn how to patch test, which ingredients to introduce slowly, a week-by-week plan, and when to see a dermatologist.
quick: Avocado cream can feel comfortable on sensitive skin, but start slowly because it contains niacinamide and kojic acid. Patch test for three nights, then use it every third night for two weeks and build up only if skin stays calm. Wear sunscreen daily.
facts: Patch test behind the ear or on the jaw for three nights
Start every third night, then build up
A brief tingle can be normal; burning is not
See a dermatologist for rashes or constant redness
